Application Description

Guardian OL2 is a retro-style 3D action MMORPG where one hero lives in two worlds. Adventure online with real players, or slip into your private Solo World — your character, gear and diamonds follow you everywhere. TWO WORLDS, ONE HERO • Multiplayer World — a living online realm: team up for dungeons, trade on the auction house, climb the leaderboards • Solo World — a private copy of the continent on your own schedule: no queues, no competition, just you and your followers • One roster — switch freely; progress, items and wallet are shared FIVE CLASSES • Knights Templar — holy knight whose healing and blessings keep the party alive • Magician — fragile but devastating master of fire, frost and arcane power • Witcher — swift blood-clan marksman with precision shots and paralyzing arrows • Greatsword Warrior — titan-born bulwark with taunts, shield walls and crushing blows • Berserker — dwarven fire-worshipper who whirlwinds through enemy ranks A CONTINENT TO CONQUER Follow your class's own storyline across villages, frozen tundras, spider caves and haunted tombs to Gran Village, the hub city where the real hunt begins. Quests, elites and world drops fill every corner. DUNGEONS & BOSSES Fight through the Wolf Lair, Spider Nest, Mystic Tomb, Gruel's Lair and the Dark Lair. Every boss — the Bloodthirsty Wolf King, the Red Dragon, Abalak the Spider, Skeleton King Leon, the Devil Naros — brings a signature trick: summons, freezes, poison, stuns. THREE RISK MODES • Normal — no death penalty; perfect for learning • Nightmare — death costs coins and crystals; better loot and XP • Hell — brutal penalties, the richest drops, and open-world PvP LIFE SKILLS & GEAR Mine ore, gather herbs, fish and hunt — then forge weapons, cook buff food, brew potions and enchant equipment. Enhance, socket gems, and decompose spare gear. Recipe scrolls drop in the wild. Set pieces grant bonus power. TRADE, FOLLOWERS & FACTIONS Sell your loot to real players on the auction house. Hire followers — bats, treants, stone golems, mushroom folk — to fight beside you. Build reputation with five factions (Order of the Holy Light, Titan Legion, Hidden Alliance, Fire of Armas, The Source of Life) and exchange it for exclusive gear. DAILY REWARDS Login gifts, daily deals, daily chests, achievements and server rankings keep every session rewarding. NOW IN 18 LANGUAGES English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Türkçe, العربية, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia. The same account works on iOS and Android — progress is never lost. Premium game: pay once, no ads. Optional in-app purchases (diamonds, membership) available.

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺149,99 → ₺49,99 [₺29,99 ~ ₺199,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺49,99

Application Description

Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground. Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out. Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing. Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs: • Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency • Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement • Optimise routes to maximise each descent Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all. Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb towards mastering what lies below. Top 10 casual game in the UK and US, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun! What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history. Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun. Features: • intuitive one-finger portrait controls • short runs that fit easily into a minute or two • persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition • multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises • resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation • a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress • a market system for trading what you bring back • progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run • a calm, cosy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it • no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems • achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

Expand your skill tree, combine cards and relics, and wipe out the slime hordes filling the screen in a single sweep! ■ Visible Progress with Every Fight Defeat slimes to earn resources and loot, then upgrade your character and weapons. Enemies that once felt overwhelming can be defeated in an instant as your progress builds up. Experience the fun of an incremental game as you grow stronger, hunt faster, and earn more rewards. ■ A Skill Tree That Grows with Your Choices Choose your preferred path of progression, including attack power, attack speed, and special abilities. Upgrade and combine mercenaries to create more efficient combat strategies. ■ Weapons That Grow Endlessly Stronger Upgrading your weapons increases both their attack range and firepower. Break through the limits of progression and sweep away the incoming slime hordes with overwhelming attacks. All the power you have accumulated comes alive through explosive, satisfying hits. ■ Simple Controls, Deep Progression Enjoy intuitive controls that anyone can pick up, along with a wide variety of progression systems. Combat is simple, but different combinations of skill trees, cards, relics, mercenaries, and weapons allow you to create entirely different progression strategies. ■ The Secret of No More Slimes!! The once-peaceful Mialreut Gorge has been occupied by a mysterious slime army. Hunt the endless waves of slimes and grow beyond your limits. Can you uncover the true culprit behind this massive chaos and restore peace to the gorge? Embark on more than a dozen Challenges that will test your wit and cunning. Compete for badges in the rotating Skirmish Mode where no two games are the same! Control the Spice. Control the Universe. Arrakis. Dune. Desert Planet. Raise your banner above the vast wasteland before you. As the Great Houses of the Landsraad marshal their forces and their spies, whom will you influence, and whom will you betray? A tyrannical Emperor. The secretive Bene Gesserit. The shrewd Spacing Guild. The ferocious Fremen of the Deep Desert. The power of the Imperium can be yours, but war is not the only way to claim it. Dune: Imperium blends deck-building and worker placement in a deeply thematic new strategy game where the fate of the Empire hangs on your decisions. Will you seek political allies or rely upon military might? Economic strength or subtle intrigues? A council seat… or a sharpened blade? The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans. Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are: BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions. ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo. CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards). ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks. SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money. With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Application Description

Atomic Space Age was a blast! Until it became the Post-Apocalyptic Space Age. Your space station is about to explode and you only have 60 seconds before things get messy. What (or who) will you grab before you make a mad dash for the emergency shuttle and begin your journey into THE GREAT UNKNOWN? This is 60 Parsecs!, a dark comedy sci-fi adventure set in the Atomic Space Age - complete with all the Cold War paranoia, chrome-plated wall accents and cockroaches with space helmets. Lead a crew of woefully unprepared astronauts, equipped with whatever junk - sorry - "supplies" you can grab before blasting off, on a journey across the cosmos that's best described as misguided. Make the best of it, while dealing with soup shortages and other horrors of outer space. Will you have what it takes to find a new home and survive? Bon voyage! SCAVENGE & EVACUATE With only 60 seconds before nukes reduce the space station to floating particles in the vacuum of space, frantically grab whatever supplies and crew you can before getting out of there. You never know when that sock puppet will come in handy. SURVIVE & DECIDE Space funerals are inconvenient, so try to avoid dying where possible. Use your limited supplies and (hopefully not limited) wits to make difficult choices and ensure your survival, even though the odds are definitely stacked against you. EXPLORE & CRAFT Duct tape fixes all problems, but how do you fix (or at least craft) duct tape? Chart expeditions to find resources, craft survival essentials and explore strange new worlds in a procedural, very-much-permadeath adventure. LEAD & PROTECT As captain, it's your duty to keep the crew happy - they're less likely to kill you that way. Manage relationships as you watch them grow closer and hopefully not throw each other out the airlock.
